scenes.title: The Mysterious Pawprint
scenes.story_beat: Leia spots one magical pawprint beside the palace garden gate and leans in with a curious smile.
scenes.coloring_composition: Large Leia + one oversized pawprint + simple flowers and gate; strong opening silhouette.

scenes.title: A Trail Through the Flowers
scenes.story_beat: A few pawprints lead Leia through a cheerful flower garden.
scenes.coloring_composition: Leia walking in profile; 3–4 big flowers, butterflies, spacious path.

scenes.title: The Secret Garden Arch
scenes.story_beat: The pawprints slip beneath a leafy arch Leia has never noticed before.
scenes.coloring_composition: Leia beneath a simple vine arch; open path beyond; minimal background.

scenes.title: Hello, Little Butterfly
scenes.story_beat: Leia pauses when a butterfly lands beside the next pawprint.
scenes.coloring_composition: Close character moment; Leia seated, butterfly near nose, one pawprint clue.

scenes.title: Stepping-Stone Courage
scenes.story_beat: The trail crosses a tiny brook, and Leia carefully hops across big stepping stones.
scenes.coloring_composition: Clear stepping stones, gentle water lines, Leia mid-hop; no busy scenery.

scenes.title: A Friend Needs Help
scenes.story_beat: Leia finds a little bunny whose flower crown has fallen apart and stops to help.
scenes.coloring_composition: Leia + bunny + a few large flowers; kindness beat with simple shapes.

scenes.title: The Pawprint Under the Mushroom
scenes.story_beat: The next clue peeks out from beneath a giant storybook mushroom.
scenes.coloring_composition: One oversized mushroom, Leia crouching, pawprint visible; whimsical but uncluttered.

scenes.title: Through the Twinkly Woods
scenes.story_beat: Leia follows the trail between friendly trees where tiny stars seem to hide in the leaves.
scenes.coloring_composition: Three simple tree trunks, star shapes, Leia centered; generous white space.

scenes.title: The Tiny Bridge
scenes.story_beat: A little wooden bridge carries Leia and her new bunny friend across the stream.
scenes.coloring_composition: Side-view bridge, two characters, simple water and reeds.

scenes.title: A Brave Little Climb
scenes.story_beat: The pawprints climb a gentle hill, and Leia keeps going even when the path gets steep.
scenes.coloring_composition: Leia climbing a rounded hill with pawprints ahead; clouds and one flower patch.

scenes.title: The Wishing Well
scenes.story_beat: At the top, Leia finds a wishing well with a pawprint on one stone.
scenes.coloring_composition: Large well as central object, Leia beside it; open sky, minimal vines.

scenes.title: A Crown-Shaped Key
scenes.story_beat: Inside a little bucket, Leia discovers a key shaped like a tiny crown.
scenes.coloring_composition: Close-up scene: Leia, bucket, large easy-to-color key; few surrounding details.

scenes.title: The Hidden Garden Door
scenes.story_beat: The crown key opens a small door tucked into an old garden wall.
scenes.coloring_composition: Rounded door, simple stones, Leia turning the key; pawprint motif on door.

scenes.title: The Room of Pawprints
scenes.story_beat: Inside is a cozy little room decorated with pawprints, cushions, and one empty frame.
scenes.coloring_composition: Simple interior: cushion, frame, 3 pawprint motifs; Leia looking around.

scenes.title: The Mirror Surprise
scenes.story_beat: Leia looks into a mirror and notices the same magical pawprint symbol beside her own paw.
scenes.coloring_composition: Leia + large oval mirror + one pawprint symbol; simple reveal composition.

scenes.title: Magic Grows with Kindness
scenes.story_beat: Leia realizes the trail appeared whenever she was curious, brave, or kind.
scenes.coloring_composition: Leia with bunny and butterfly; three large symbolic sparkles/pawprints around them.

scenes.title: Leaving a Pawprint for a Friend
scenes.story_beat: Leia presses one paw gently into soft garden earth, leaving a new magical clue for someone else.
scenes.coloring_composition: Leia making a pawprint in soil; one friend watching; big clear ground shapes.

scenes.title: Follow the Magic Home
scenes.story_beat: Leia and her friends follow the final pawprints back toward the palace as stars begin to appear.
scenes.coloring_composition: Rear/three-quarter walking pose; simple palace silhouette, 3–4 stars, pawprint trail.

scenes.title: Every Kind Step Leaves Magic
scenes.story_beat: Leia sits happily at home with her friends, one little pawprint sparkling beside them.
scenes.coloring_composition: Warm finale portrait: Leia + bunny + butterfly, crown, single pawprint motif, lots of white space.
